mods.title: Stone Plaza Recolor
mods.author: PepperPepperPepper
mods.summary: Give the plaza the same stone finish as the paths around it.
mods.description: This recolor changes the plaza floor. The surrounding buildings and the rest of the island keep their original textures.

mods.title: iHud
mods.author: inconsistent
mods.summary: Hide the map, phone, clock and date for a clear island view.
mods.description: Made for screenshots and video, iHud removes the usual heads-up display while you move around the island.

mods.title: Square grass
mods.author: Praecantetia
mods.summary: Bring the square grass pattern from earlier Animal Crossing games to your island.
mods.description: The new ground texture replaces the default grass pattern with a repeating square motif.

mods.title: 360° Outdoor Cam
mods.author: Alree
mods.summary: Rotate the outdoor camera all the way around your character.
mods.description: Alree lists support for game versions 1.2 through 1.6 and describes interaction limits on the release page.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

mods.title: Hyrule Rebeautified
mods.author: WarioSnap
mods.summary: Rework Hyrule’s biomes, weather and light with a customizable visual overhaul.
mods.description: The project offers options for atmosphere, fog, clouds and lighting. Version 2.0.0 exposes the visual choices through TKMM.

mods.title: UI Dark Mode
mods.author: anoeye
mods.summary: Darken the loading screen used when Link teleports.
mods.description: This is a focused color change to the teleport loading interface.

mods.title: Vanilla+
mods.author: VyraNightingale
mods.summary: A collection of balance and quality-of-life changes for another trip through Hyrule.
mods.description: VyraNightingale adjusts items and game systems while keeping the overall structure of the original adventure. The host maintains the full change list and creator credits.

mods.title: Clean UI / Minimal UI
mods.author: Dziggy
mods.summary: Choose how much of the interface stays on screen.
mods.description: Dziggy publishes several HUD arrangements. The original listing explains what each variant changes and which game versions it covers.

mods.title: Squirtle with Glasses
mods.author: IvoNewmaN
mods.summary: Give Squirtle, Wartortle and Blastoise their own Squirtle Squad shades.
mods.description: IvoNewmaN modeled sunglasses for the entire evolution line. The creator publishes the pack on Nexus Mods and GameBanana and lists Trinity Mod Loader in the release instructions.

mods.title: New Shiny Dragonite
mods.author: Miowo
mods.summary: Recolor shiny Dragonite using Dragonair’s palette.
mods.description: Miowo includes the main recolor and an alternate cyan version. The gallery shows the creator’s thumbnail and an in-game preview.

mods.title: Bye Bye CrossHair
mods.author: ElChicoEevee
mods.summary: Remove the crosshair when the camera interface is hidden.
mods.description: The change leaves a clear frame for recording or photographing a scene in camera mode.

mods.title: Legends ZA Kaizo
mods.author: pokemonjohn56
mods.summary: A harder campaign with revised Pokémon typings, moves and evolutions.
mods.description: The host links the project’s trainer data and change notes, including updates to evolution methods and selected Pokémon forms.

mods.title: Aviator Daisy
mods.author: Z_444
mods.summary: Give Daisy’s Aero outfit a new aviator look.
mods.description: Z_444’s release replaces the outfit model and includes matching interface art and a name change.

mods.title: Looping Routes
mods.author: LiamWins
mods.summary: Race custom routes that curve back to their starting track.
mods.description: LiamWins designed these routes to feel like complete loops. The host credits Shortcat as an inspiration and lists the available routes.

mods.title: Quiet Kart World
mods.author: fungiazz
mods.summary: Turn off background music while keeping engines, drifting, items and voices audible.
mods.description: This release changes the race sound mix. The original listing describes its RomFS edition and the sounds it preserves.

mods.title: Daisy’s Palace
mods.author: hydro sucks
mods.summary: Race a semi-custom palace course in place of Shy-Guy Bazaar.
mods.description: The creator’s page lists game version 1.0.0 and the race modes used for this track.

mods.title: Redesign: Grown Suit
mods.author: Greedalf
mods.summary: Watch Samus’s armor take on a more organic look as her suit progresses.
mods.description: Greedalf redesigns the suit stages to evoke the original Varia silhouette and make the changes between upgrades more visible.

mods.title: Fusion Varia Suit colors
mods.author: ToaRex
mods.summary: Bring the Varia Suit palette from Metroid Fusion into Dread.
mods.description: ToaRex applies the earlier game’s colors to the Dread Varia Suit. Additional screenshots and contributor credits are on the host.

mods.title: Dread Randomizer
mods.author: Randovania team
mods.summary: Shuffle item locations, transit destinations, door locks and starting positions.
mods.description: The community project also offers a DNA Hunt goal. Its Dread page lists the supported game versions and the tools needed to play a generated seed.

mods.title: Gravity Suit Redesign
mods.author: Hario337
mods.summary: Give the Gravity Suit a design inspired by earlier Metroid armor.
mods.description: Hario337’s visual redesign changes the look of the Gravity Suit. The original listing includes the creator’s comparison images.
